about: Calibration set for loop.sh --calibrate (T-983). SOURCE.md is synthetic interview notes. clean.bpmn is a map an agent generated from it that two reviewers and an audit found faithful (T-982 S1). planted.bpmn is clean.bpmn with three known defects. A calibrated reviewer catches all three and reports nothing on clean.bpmn. Measured with GLM-5.2 on 2026-10-01: 3/3 caught, 0 false findings (T-982 S1b; the warehouse finding was rated minor, which rubric v3 now forbids).
